def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # Build children mapping and id to node dict
    children = {}
    node_by_id = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        node_by_id[nid] = node
        parent = node['parent']
        if parent is not None:
            children.setdefault(parent, []).append(nid)
    # Initialize retained set with all ids
    retained = set(node_by_id.keys())
    # Sort nodes: depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    removed = []
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if nid == 'root':
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check if any child retained
        has_retained_child = False
        for child_id in children.get(nid, []):
            if child_id in retained:
                has_retained_child = True
                break
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # can remove
        removed.append(nid)
        retained.remove(nid)
    retained_list = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_list
    }
